ZinELF64.Target: Linux/BSD x86_64 where ELF64 is used
ZinELF64.Executable: Integrated linker must be able to emit a directly executable static ELF for libc-free Zin programs.
ZinELF64.DynamicLinking: May be added after static/bootstrap path; foreign shared-library loading is platform tooling, not core language semantics.
